### Opal {#review-app-1}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      17 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: Jun 8, 2026 - Aug 3, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Vinny_179_, Aug 3, 2026, 1/5: "I’ve been using this app nonstop for over a year now. It’s been amazing and a great help in controlling my scrolling on social media. Lately though the app has gotten a lot harder to navigate. With each new update I need to completely relearn how to use the app as the actual point of the app, for screen time control, gets buried deeper and deeper in all the extra features they keep adding. The app was great to begin with. Please stop going crazy with all the new updates and features because it’s getting harder to navigate around and access the actual app blocking menu which was the whole point of the app to begin with. Now all the settings have been changed and the app has become useless and unusable. I’m very sad but I have to drop the app after using it for over a year. Update: I am now deleting the app and switching to Jomo. The app has stopped working like it is supposed to. The timeouts sometimes work and sometimes don’t. And sometimes even if I have blocks on, all the apps are still able to be used and reloading blocked apps doesn’t fix anything. The app isn’t serving its intended purpose. So sad, but it was good while it lasted."
            2. _Rda_Y_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "Since the last updates the application has become unusable and filled with freezes, the UI is way too busy. Get back to a more refined style and to the basis of what your application really is.."
            3. _tassneem.a_, Jul 22, 2026, 1/5: "First time i downloaded the app it worked perfectly, but now the screen is always freezing on the app.."

         **Review examples:**
            1. _alitur43_, Jul 25, 2026, 1/5: "I tried this app a couple of years ago as I loved it on my laptop, and I decided to try it again because I assumed that by now they should have fixed the iPad/iPhone functionality up a bit. I was wrong. I actually don't understand how you can have such an appalling usability as an app but be so good on the web, and continue to stay unusable as an app for years at a time despite all the reviews telling you how bad your app is. I can't access templates (FREE templates) on my iPad, it takes me 30 seconds to open old notes, the dashboard and sidebar glitch around once a minute, I struggle to load things up, it drains my battery stupidly quickly and don't even get me STARTED on trying to type things/use the keyboard. Seriously, why is it so hard to do literally anything on the app? The degree to which things STILL don't work after 2 years is surreal to me."
            2. _zac-attac_, Jul 24, 2026, 1/5: "I have paid for the Notion Plus subscription for some time. I was worried when they introduced AI features but I stuck with it because I liked the product and they had been good so far. I regret that now. The app is still horrible and slow on mobile, nearly as bad on desktop, buggy, doesn’t give power users the features they need. STILL I paid for my subscription even though the app never improved. But today is the straw that broke the camel’s back: I pay for Plus but I can’t retrieve document versions older than 90 days without paying even MORE for an Enterprise plan? I’m going to be getting my things off this platform as soon as possible. I can’t support this anymore. If the app gets overhauled, I’ll check in again. But I can’t put up with no improvements AND being nickel-and-dimed for basic features that should be included in my subscription. You had a great idea and you’ve run it into the ground."
            3. _Broken app garbage_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "Each update makes the app slower. Critical features get hidden behind AI features - like search. IOS widgets are super buggy. The share widget is completely broken. The app is unusable at some points."
